We ran 3 Alphafold2 predictions,

- HIV-PR_monomer \_ HIV-PR_dimer
- My find-a-gene protein sequence

Here we analyze the resulting models and make some diagnostic plots that inform on model reliability

##1. HIV-PR Monomer

### Read the 5 AF models




```{r}
list.files(path="HIVPR_monomer_03c0b.result", full.names=T, pattern="*.pdb")
```

```{r}
pdb_files <- list.files(path="HIV_monomer", full.names=T, pattern="*.pdb")
pdb_files
```

```{r}
library(bio3d)

pdbs <- pdbaln(pdb_files, fit=TRUE, exefile "msa")
pdbs
```

```{r}
rd <- rnsd(pdbs, fit=T)
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

colnames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
rownames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
pheatmap(rd)
```

calculate RMSF - how far apart each amino-acid is across all 5 AlphaFold models

```{r}
rf <- rmsf(pdbs$xyz)
plot.bio3d(rf)
```

##2. HIV-PR Dimer

### RMSD

### RMSF

### Residue Conservation

Read the AF MSA

```{r}
aln_file <- list.files(path="HIV_monomer_03c0b/",
                       pattern=".a3m$",
                        full.names = TRUE)
#aln_file
aln <- read.fasta(aln_file[1], to.upper = TRUE)

```

```{r}
sim <- conserv(aln)

```

Plot this conservation result

```{r}
plot(sim, typ="h")
```

```{r}
con <- consensus(aln, cutoff = 0.88)
con$seq
```

```{r}
m1.pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_files[1])
occ <- vec2resno(c(sim[1:99], sim[1:99]), m1.pdb$atom$resno)
write.pdb(m1.pdb, o=occ, file="m1_conserv.pdb")
```

\^ P .. DTGAD for 0.9 there will be D and G

### AF scores (pLDD & PAE score plots)

The pLDDT scores are stored in the PDB models "B-factor" col and in a separate JSON format file in the results directory. We can use either:

```{r}
plotb3(pdbs$b[1,], typ="l", lwd=2, sse=pdb)
points(pdbs$b[2,], typ="l", col="red")
points(pdbs$b[3,], typ="l", col="blue")
points(pdbs$b[4,], typ="l", col="darkgreen")
points(pdbs$b[5,], typ="l", col="orange")

#plot(m1.pdb$atom$b[m1.pdb$calpha], typ ="h")
```
